name: Bit Plane Quantization
definition: Lossy compression technique representing each wavelet coefficient $F_i$ (double-precision float) as a sum of $J < 8$ one-byte integers ($Q_i^{(j)}$) with offsets and steps, to enable entropy coding.
summary: Bit plane quantization is a lossy compression technique that represents wavelet coefficients as sums of one-byte integers, differing from scalar quantization by using multiple adaptive levels.
